description: List the current user's own individual time entries for a date range: for each, its time_report_id (what update_time_report and delete_time_report take), date, start and end time of day on the organization's clock, project and subtask names and ids, hours, description, billable flag and status. Use this to see exactly what was logged (the per-entry detail), as opposed to aggregated totals, and to find the entry the user wants to change or delete.

end_date.description: End date of the range (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-31)

limit.description: Optional maximum number of entries to return (1-200, default 200). Entries are returned most-recent first.

start_date.description: Start date of the range (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01)

name: list_my_time_entries
